title: The Voice Before the Storm
intro: A figure in the desert rose to call a powerful nation back to the truth. The people were known for their magnificent buildings and unmatched strength. Yet their pride blinded them, and they refused to listen. Eventually, a devastating punishment befell them, sparing only a small group of believers.
clues: I was sent to a powerful people who lived in the open lands and were known for their might.
My people came after another great nation that had been destroyed.
They had magnificent structures and built high towers.
I called them to worship One God, but they refused to abandon their idols.
A violent punishment overtook them, sparing only those who believed with me.
I am the one sent to a mighty people known as Aad.

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: An earthquake and a terrifying cry

location.label: Key Element
options: A great ark built on a mountain
A staff that became a serpent

outcome.label: Outcome
options: All drowned in a great flood
My people destroyed by a violent wind, while I was saved
My people struck by an earthquake and cry
My people pelted with stones from the sky
My people thrown into a blazing fire
outcome.answer: My people destroyed by a violent wind, while I was saved

arabic: أَوَعَجِبْتُمْ أَن جَآءَكُمْ ذِكْرٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍۢ مِّنكُمْ لِيُنذِرَكُمْ ۚ وَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ إِذْ جَعَلَكُمْ خُلَفَآءَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ قَوْمِ نُوحٍۢ وَزَادَكُمْ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ بَصْۜطَةًۭ ۖ فَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ ءَالَآءَ ٱللَّهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
verse: Then do you wonder that there has come to you a reminder from your Lord through a man from among you, that he may warn you? And remember when He made you successors after the people of Noah and increased you in stature extensively. So remember the favors of Allāh that you might succeed." (7:69)
